sections.title: Call card and lock handling
sections.what: Draws the call card for a moment and sends the pick to the server when Lock is pressed. Handles sign-in needed, already locked, and other failures, and shows a review link after success.
sections.why: The comment says the server records the call, so the browser only shows the outcome.
sections.watch_out: Leverage is divided by 0.5 and capped at 1, so very high values look the same once capped. The meter text about the top 10 percent is fixed.

summary: The call card for one Decision Lab moment: shows the situation and lets a signed-in fan lock in one pick and a confidence level.
purpose: Lets a fan record their call on a moment.
why: The code comment says the server records the call and the server time, with one pick per call.
how: Shows the question, the context values, the leverage meter and the options. Pressing Lock sends the choice and confidence to the server. A 401 response asks for sign-in, a 409 response means the call already exists and shows a review link, and other failures show the server message. Success shows the review link.
inputs: The moment data, the chosen option and confidence from the Ticket, and the sign-in state.
outputs: The call card, error messages, a sign-in link, and a review link after success.
risks: Confidence is divided by 100 before sending, so the scale must match what the Ticket produces. The server enforces one call, not this file. Player names are plain text.
debug: If locking fails, check the response status and the api/lab/calls route. If confidence is off by a factor of 100, check the Ticket's lock value. If the review link is missing after a reload, check the 409 path.
